name: WDS Documentation Navigator
headline: Wix Design System: Component Lookup Tool
short_description: We build custom AI skills and automations for B2B companies.
author: wix

sections.overview:
The wix-design-system skill is an AI agent tool that provides instant access to Wix Design System documentation, helping developers quickly find component properties, usage examples, and icon references. Integrated with AI agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI, it eliminates manual documentation searches and accelerates development workflows. The skill works within the new Wix CLI ecosystem and supports any agent built on the Agent Skills specification. Developers building Wix app extensions or using the @wix/design-system library can reference component APIs and examples directly during coding without leaving their editor.
Find components by keyword
Get props and example list for specific components
Retrieve specific examples by name
Search for icons in the design system
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/wix/skills --skill wds-docs`
`git clone https://github.com/wix/skills`
